author: BoldAndBrash
body:
So I was playing a game of Nexus, and noticed that the opposing team had snipers bow spamming our spawn. I tried eporting, no one came. So I decided to make some suggestions....

»NOTE THESE ARE ALL DIFFERENT IDEAS«

1. Being Killed.
Basically, if the enemy attempts to spawnkill a player who just spawned, it will say "Do Not Spawn Kill!" If they attempt to attack a total of 3x, they will be insta-killed.

2. Paralyze
If the spawnkiller attempts to spawnkill 3x he will be paralyzed for 15 seconds.

3. Simple Protection
Lets say some n00b wants to spawnkill with arrows. If he shoots an arrow, the spawn will act as a forcefield. The arrows will simply bounce off. This suggestion also makes it so enemies cannot come within 5 blocks of the spawn.



That's it. : )
